materials.name: Base Apricot
materials.odour: aroma fruity manis, juicy, lembut, dengan nuansa aprikot matang, sedikit peach-like, creamy, dan sedikit lactonic, memberikan kesan halus, hangat, dan sedikit powdery

materials.name: Base Bergamot
materials.odour: A citrus aroma that reconstructs the character of natural bergamot, offering notes that are fresh, sparkling, zesty, juicy, slightly sweet, and reminiscent of citrus peel, with floral and subtle tea-like nuances.

materials.name: Base Cassis
materials.odour: A highly distinctive and diffusive fruity-green aroma featuring nuances of blackcurrant bud, a "catty" sulfuric freshness, green leafy tartness, dark berry sweetness, and a touch of wine-like fruitiness, alongside a sharp, modern, and juicy tropical-blackcurrant realism.

materials.name: Base Citrus Animalic
materials.odour: A bright and fresh citrus aroma, blended with warm animalic nuances—slightly musky, leathery, and sensual.

materials.name: Base Civet
materials.odour: A highly sensual animalic-musky aroma with nuances of warm skin, soft-fecal, leathery, creamy, slightly urinous, indolic, and sweet, dirty warmth.

materials.name: Base Clove Stem
materials.odour: A warm, dry, woody, slightly smoky, and medicinal spicy-eugenolic aroma, featuring nuances of clove bud, cinnamon, carnation, phenolic sweetness, and the dark aromatic depth characteristic of clove stems.

materials.name: Base Creamy Manggo
materials.odour: A sweet, juicy, fruity aroma characteristic of ripe mango, blended with creamy, smooth, and slightly lactonic nuances, resulting in a profile that feels silky, tropical, and slightly milky.

materials.name: Base Frangipani
materials.odour: A rich, tropical, creamy-white floral scent featuring nuances of plumeria, jasmine, ylang-ylang, peach, coconut milk, and solar florals, along with a soft, exotic sweetness that is both sensual and sunny.

materials.name: Base Fresh Peony
materials.odour: A fresh, soft, and slightly watery floral scent with nuances of peony, light rose, and subtle green and airy notes, creating a clean, fresh, and elegant impression.

materials.name: Base Green Apple
materials.odour: A juicy, crisp, and fresh fruity-green aroma featuring notes of fresh green apple—slightly tart, watery, and candy-like—alongside a clean, natural green-peel nuance.

materials.name: Base Jasmine Tea
materials.odour: aroma floral lembut khas jasmine yang dipadukan dengan nuansa teh (tea-like), sedikit green, ringan, dan sedikit sweet, memberikan kesan tenang, elegan, dan natural seperti teh melati hangat

materials.name: Base Leather
materials.odour: A deep, smoky, softly animalic, slightly tarry, woody-balsamic, and dry leathery aroma with an elegant, sensual, suede-like nuance.

materials.name: Base Leather Spicy
materials.odour: A warm leathery aroma, blended with spicy nuances—such as pepper and wood—and a hint of smokiness, creates an impression that is strong, masculine, warm, and slightly rugged yet elegant.

materials.name: Base Mocca
materials.odour: A warm, sweet, coffee-like aroma with hints of chocolate, roasted notes, and a touch of creaminess; it evokes a gourmand quality—deep and with a bittersweet character reminiscent of a mocha.

materials.name: Base Nectarine / Honey
materials.odour: A juicy, nectar-like, and honeyed fruity-gourmand aroma with nuances of ripe nectarine, peach, apricot, floral nectar, and honey syrup.

materials.name: Base Peach
materials.odour: A juicy, soft, and creamy fruity aroma with nuances of ripe peach, apricot, nectarine, and floral nectar, and a slight lactonic quality.

materials.name: Base Pistachio Cream
materials.odour: A creamy, nutty, and slightly sweet gourmand aroma featuring nuances of roasted pistachio, almond-like nuttiness, vanilla cream, lactonic dairy, and buttery warmth, alongside a smooth, edible, soft green-nut undertone.

materials.name: Base Rose
materials.odour: A distinctive sweet, soft, and slightly fresh rose-floral aroma—with nuances of honey, a touch of green, and powdery notes—evoking a romantic, elegant, and natural impression.

materials.name: Base Sultan Oud
materials.odour: aroma oud yang kuat, woody, dark, smoky, sedikit animalic, dengan nuansa resinous, spicy, dan sedikit manis hangat, memberikan kesan mewah, dalam, dan oriental

materials.name: Base Tuberose White Floral
materials.odour: A creamy, sweet, and rich white floral scent with a distinctive tuberose nuance that is slightly lactonic, buttery, and green.

materials.name: Base Tuscan Wine
materials.odour: A rich and sensual boozy-fruity aroma featuring nuances of red wine, dark grape, plum, raisin, oak barrel, and a slightly fermented sweetness, alongside a luxurious, mature depth of warm balsamic and woody notes.

materials.name: Base Vegan Beeswax
materials.odour: A soft, natural, warm-waxy aroma with nuances of honeycomb, soft pollen, creamy balsamic sweetness, slightly animalic wax, and a cozy, elegant, warm resinous depth reminiscent of skin.

materials.name: Base Violet
materials.odour: A soft, airy, and elegant floral-powdery scent featuring nuances of violet petals, ionone-like sweetness, green leafy freshness, soft cosmetic powder, and a modern, romantic, slightly woody-floral transparency.

materials.name: Base Zesty Green
materials.odour: A bright, juicy, and energetic green-citrus aroma featuring nuances of crushed leaves, lime zest, green apple peel, and aromatic herbs, alongside a slightly watery quality and modern, vibrant, sparkling fresh greenery.

rules.note: Ada alami di bergamot dan di lavender/neroli — penghubung paling klasik.
Rosy dengan sisi hangat; bantu rose ke cengkeh (efek anyelir).
Peran terkuatnya: rosy dengan sisi citrus.
Musky-lembut yang nyelimutin bunga dan kayu. Dosis tinggi jadi tajam.
Versi terang: dry amber yang bersih.
Polish woody: bikin kayu lebih halus dan cerah.
Ngasih ruang dan halo ke spice.
Blender: ngehalusin sambungan floral ke balsamic. Alergen wajib label.
Inti aroma anyelir: clove + floral. Ada batas IFRA ketat.
Violet-berry, cocok buat raspberry/plum ke powdery.
Lavender-bergamot yang lebih stabil dari linalool.
Sisi leathery-nya bisa nyambungin rose ke leather.
Lebih segar dan citrusy dari geraniol.
Patchouli ringan: kayu ke balsamic tanpa terlalu tanah.
Pedas yang segar, nyambungin top citrus ke spice.
Musk bersih yang nempel ke bunga.
Ambergris radiant; tulang punggung amber-woody modern.
Saffron: jembatan leather ke raspberry (pola Tuscan Leather). Dosis sangat kecil.
